_meta.research_notes: How one ad becomes many targeted variants inside today's ad stacks. Every platform below already supports (a) multiple creatives under one campaign and (b) audience/geo splits at the ad-set / ad-group / line-item level. None of them generate per-segment creative — that is the Sonic Segments layer. Key empirical shift: Meta's Andromeda ranking engine evaluates orders of magnitude more creative permutations than before, so 'creative is the new targeting' — platforms now REWARD advertisers who bring many audience-tuned variants, which is exactly what we produce.

variant_mechanism.name: One ad set per audience, one Sonic Segments cut per ad set
variant_mechanism.how: Meta targeting lives on the AD SET. We emit one ad set per (segment x mood x geo) with its matched cut attached as the ad creative. Optionally the cuts can also be pooled into a single Advantage+/flexible ad and let Andromeda pick — but explicit ad sets keep the audience-to-music mapping measurable, which is the product's proof point.
variant_mechanism.measurement: Per-ad-set CTR/CPA compare = direct A/B of music per audience.

targeting.interests: Detailed targeting: interest nodes include music genres, artists, festivals, sports teams
targeting.music_specific: Artist and genre interest nodes (e.g. 'Country music', 'Hip hop music', 'Afrobeats')

delivery.api: Marketing API (Graph API): POST /act_{ad_account_id}/adsets with a targeting spec, /advideos for upload, /adcreatives, /ads
delivery.test_mode: Sandbox ad account (no spend, full API surface) + create everything status=PAUSED in production accounts

variant_mechanism.name: One ad group per audience inside a Demand Gen campaign
variant_mechanism.how: Demand Gen (successor to Video Action campaigns) carries multiple ad groups; each ad group gets its own audience (affinity / custom segment / demographics / geo) and its own Sonic Segments cut. Google's affinity taxonomy includes 150+ segments with explicit MUSIC AFFINITIES (Country Music Fans, Rap & Hip Hop Fans, Electronica & Dance Music Fans...) — we map our demographic segments straight onto them.

targeting.interests: Affinity segments (150+), In-Market, Custom segments (keyword/URL), Life Events
targeting.music_specific: Music affinity segments per genre; custom segments from artist keywords

creative_specs.container: Hosted on YouTube (upload as unlisted), referenced by video ID
creative_specs.notes: >=10s for in-feed; 6s bumper cutdowns possible from the same render

delivery.api: Google Ads API; bulk via Google Ads Editor CSV import
delivery.test_mode: Google Ads test manager accounts (no serving, full API validation); campaigns created PAUSED

variant_mechanism.name: One line item / YouTube ad group per audience via Structured Data Files
variant_mechanism.how: DV360 is the doorway to the living-room vision: YouTube TV and CTV inventory is bought here, and targeting (geo, demo, audience lists, device=ConnectedTV) sits on LINE ITEMS and YouTube AD GROUPS. SDF (CSV bulk format, v9.x) lets us generate the whole trafficking tree offline — one line item per Sonic Segments variant — and the trader uploads it in one click. This is exactly how a Gatorade ad gets a different score in Atlanta living rooms vs Nashville living rooms today, no new ad tech required.
variant_mechanism.measurement: Line-item level completion rate / brand lift

targeting.music_specific: Music affinity segments; audio-genre contextual on audio inventory
targeting.device: ConnectedTV device targeting isolates the TV screen

creative_specs.notes: CTV is non-skippable 15/30s — the full-quality render matters most here

delivery.api: Display & Video 360 API + Structured Data Files (SDF v9.x)
delivery.test_mode: SDF validates on upload without activating; line items created Draft/Paused

variant_mechanism.name: One ad group per audience
variant_mechanism.how: Targeting lives on the AD GROUP: age, gender, geo (US: state/DMA/city/radius), interests, hashtag-interaction bundles, behaviors. One Sonic Segments cut per ad group; Smart+ can be layered on top but manual ad groups keep the music-per-audience experiment clean.

targeting.interests: Interest categories from watch behavior + hashtag interaction bundles
targeting.music_specific: Music-related interest categories and artist/genre hashtag bundles

creative_specs.notes: 9-15s awareness, 15-30s conversion; value in first 3 seconds. Sound-ON platform — music choice matters more here than anywhere

delivery.api: TikTok Marketing API: /adgroup/create/ with targeting object, /ad/create/
delivery.test_mode: TikTok sandbox ad accounts; operation_status=DISABLE on create

variant_mechanism.name: One ad set per audience; genre/context targeting is native
variant_mechanism.how: The proof that hyper-targeted audio swaps already ship: Spotify inserts different ads into the SAME podcast stream per listener (Streaming Ad Insertion) — the geo-targeted podcast ads you noticed are this. Targeting: demographics + geo + ONE advanced option per ad set: interest, real-time context (workout/party/chill/commute), MUSIC GENRE currently being streamed, podcast category, or artist fan base. Our angle is unique here: we re-score the ad's music TO the genre the ad set targets — a country fan hears the brand's ad scored country, in a country playlist.
variant_mechanism.measurement: Ad-set level completion rate + Spotify Brand Lift

targeting.interests: Interest OR real-time context OR genre OR podcast category OR fan base (one per ad set)
targeting.music_specific: STRONGEST of any platform: target by streamed genre and artist fan bases

creative_specs.container: Audio: MP3/WAV, 44.1kHz, target -16 LUFS / -2.0 dBTP; we export an audio-only mix of each cut
creative_specs.notes: <=30s in Ads Manager; script <=65 words per 30s. Sonic Segments exports the re-scored AUDIO track of each variant for this channel

delivery.api: Spotify Ads Manager (self-serve UI; API in closed beta)
delivery.bulk_format: JSON brief + audio assets (manual upload today)
delivery.test_mode: Draft campaigns in Ads Manager; no public sandbox
